fullDescription: Centered single-column signup card on a light slate canvas with a sticky blurred nav, Google/GitHub social auth, an email + password form, and a cobalt CTA over a quiet engineering-grid background.

structured.summary: A centered single-column signup card on a light slate canvas, with a sticky blurred top nav, social-auth buttons (Google, GitHub), an OR divider, an email + password form, a cobalt primary CTA, and a quiet engineering grid background with subtle floating decorative chips. Warm, trustworthy SaaS aesthetic in the Resend/Linear lineage.

style.description: Clean, modern SaaS auth aesthetic: near-white slate canvas (#f8fafc), Inter typeface, cobalt-blue accent (#2563eb), soft rounded cards with layered low-opacity shadows, hairline slate borders, and a faint masked engineering grid for texture. High polish, low noise.
style.prompt: Light, premium SaaS signup screen. Background canvas #f8fafc (slate-50). Typeface: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800), antialiased, with font-feature-settings cv11 + ss01. Accent color cobalt blue: primary #2563eb (cobalt-600), hover #1d4fd0 (cobalt-700), light accent #608ffa (cobalt-400/500). Neutrals from the slate scale: headings #0f172a (slate-900), body #475569 (slate-600), muted #64748b/#94a3b8 (slate-500/400), borders #e2e8f0 (slate-200). Surfaces are white #ffffff with rounded-2xl (16px) corners, hairline slate-200 borders, and a soft layered card shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(15,23,42,.10), 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(37,99,235,.06)) plus a 1px ring rgba(15,23,42,.02). The cobalt primary button carries its own colored glow shadow (0 8px 24px -6px rgba(37,99,235,.45)). Behind everything: a faint cobalt engineering grid (1px lines rgba(37,99,235,.045) on a 56px cell) radially masked so it fades at the edges, layered with two soft cobalt radial sheen gradients. Icons via Iconify (lucide set + logos:google-icon). Restrained, confident, trustworthy.

layout_and_structure.description: Full-height flex column: a 64px sticky top nav, then a full-bleed main canvas that vertically centers a 420px-max signup column. The column stacks a logo+heading block, the white card (social buttons, OR divider, form, reassurance line), and a legal footnote below the card.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header (top:0, z-50), full width, bottom border slate-200/70, background #f8fafc at 80% opacity with a saturate(180%) blur(12px) backdrop filter. Inner row max-width 72rem (max-w-6xl), 64px tall (h-16), space-between. Left: brand lockup = 32px rounded-[10px] cobalt-600 tile with a white lucide:sparkles icon and its cobalt glow shadow, then bold 17px 'Lumen' wordmark. Center (hidden below md): nav links 'Product', 'Prompt Library', 'Pricing', 'Docs' at 14px medium slate-600, hover slate-900. Right: a 'Sign in' text link (slate-600, hidden on xs) and a solid slate-900 'Start free' pill button (13.5px semibold white, rounded-lg, px-3.5 py-2) with a trailing lucide:arrow-right.

Main is position-relative, flex-1, overflow-hidden. Two pointer-events-none absolute layers fill it: the masked cobalt grid (grid-bg) and the radial cobalt sheen. Two floating decorative chips (hidden below lg): an 88px white/70 rounded-2xl tile rotated -8deg on the left holding a cobalt lucide:layout-template icon, and a 76px tile rotated +10deg on the lower right holding a cobalt lucide:wand-2 icon, both with the card shadow and a slow 7s vertical float animation (the right one delayed -3s).
Inside a max-w-6xl px container, a flex box with min-height calc(100vh - 4rem) that centers its child both axes, padded py-12/16. The child is a single column max-width 420px.

Centered, mb-7: a 48px rounded-2xl cobalt-600 tile (white 24px lucide:sparkles, cobalt glow) above a 26px bold tracking-tight slate-900 heading 'Create your Lumen account', then a 14.5px slate-500 line 'Already have an account?' with a cobalt-600 semibold 'Log in' link.
White rounded-2xl card, border slate-200/80, padding 24px (28px at sm), the layered card shadow + slate-900/2% ring. Contains, top to bottom: social button row, OR divider, form, reassurance line.

A 1-col (2-col at sm) grid, gap-3, of two ghost buttons: white, slate-200 border, rounded-xl, px-4 py-2.5, 14px semibold slate-700, soft button shadow, hover bg #f8fafc + border slate-300. Left button = colored logos:google-icon + 'Google'; right = lucide:github + 'GitHub'.
my-5 row: a flex-1 1px slate-200 rule, the word 'or' in 11.5px medium uppercase slate-400 with 0.14em letter-spacing, then another 1px rule.

Vertical form, space-y-4. Field 1: 13px semibold slate-700 label 'Work email' over an input group = rounded-xl slate-200 border, white, px-3.5, a leading slate-400 lucide:mail icon, then a transparent 14.5px email input placeholder 'you@company.com'. Field 2: a label row with 'Password' (left) and '8+ characters' (right, 12px slate-500), over an input group with a leading lucide:lock icon, a transparent password input placeholder 'Create a password', and a trailing eye toggle button (lucide:eye / lucide:eye-off) that shows/hides the value. Each field uses a focus-within ring: box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(37,99,235,.12) and border cobalt-600. Submit: full-width cobalt-600 rounded-xl button, px-4 py-3, 14.5px semibold white, cobalt glow shadow, label 'Create account' + trailing lucide:arrow-right that nudges right on hover; hover cobalt-700, active scale .99.

Inside the card, mt-4 centered 12.5px slate-500 line with a cobalt lucide:gift icon: 'Free plan included. No card required.' Below the card, mt-6, a centered 12.5px slate-500 legal line: 'By signing up, you agree to our' with underlined slate-600 'Terms', 'Acceptable Use' and 'Privacy Policy' links.

special_ui_components.prompt: Sticky blurred nav bar (translucent #f8fafc/80 with saturate+blur backdrop filter, bottom hairline)
Masked engineering grid background (1px cobalt lines on 56px cells, radial-gradient mask fading at edges) layered with cobalt radial sheen gradients
Floating decorative icon chips (white/70 rounded tiles, slight rotation, slow 7s float keyframe animation, hidden below lg)
Social auth ghost buttons with brand icons (colored Google logo, GitHub mark)
Input groups with leading icons and a focus-within cobalt ring (4px rgba(37,99,235,.12) glow + cobalt border)
Password field with a show/hide eye toggle that swaps lucide:eye / lucide:eye-off
Cobalt primary CTA with a dedicated colored glow shadow and a hover-nudge trailing arrow

structured.special_notes: Tailwind (CDN) with a custom 'cobalt' color scale (50 #eff4ff → 600 #2563eb → 700 #1d4fd0 → 950 #172554) and three named shadows (card, softbtn, cobalt). Inter loaded from Google Fonts; icons from Iconify (lucide + logos sets). Single accent hue (cobalt) over a slate neutral system; everything else is restraint. Responsive: nav links and floating chips hide on small screens, social buttons stack to 1 column below sm, and the card stays a fixed 420px max-width centered column. The look intentionally mirrors developer-tool auth screens (Resend / Linear) where the form is the hero and the background is quiet texture, not decoration.
